rationale: Eight feeds are queued and need to be processed faster than a single worker allows, so we raise the count. However, the upstream account is capped at two concurrent workers — prior load testing confirmed that four workers caused retries and delivered lower throughput than two. No new load test or account-limit change has been recorded, so that ceiling still holds. Two is therefore the highest value that is both greater than the current baseline of one and provably sustainable on this account.
